issues.on_page: Cemetery (grouped under Public works in budget schedule p16)
issues.issue: Category rules put cemetery in health/welfare; extractor used streets/highways to tie to the statement's Public works line. Same for Perpetual Care detail[190] (p26). Defensible but contrary to the category list.

issues.on_page: Senior Center / HandiBus (Environment and leisure, budget schedule p16)
issues.issue: Senior services are health/welfare under the category rules; HandiBus (public transportation) and Airport (detail[156..164], p25, incl. 670,310 transportation and fuel) are also not culture/recreation. Kept in culture/recreation to tie to the statement's 'Environment and leisure' line; judgment call.

Label is explicit (repayment of Economic Development loans receivable) but no receipt category fits; recorded as other with review. Same for detail[206] (p19). Loan principal collections arguably aren't revenue; a person may want to decide treatment.

issues.on_page: Total column capital outlay 541,463 printed on p26
issues.issue: Discrepancy itself is correct (departments schedule total 541,463 vs governmental funds statement p6 541,163, both expenditure totals 9,248,583), but the Total column holding 541,463 is on trimmed p26, not p24.
